discoveredTools.name: kubescape_get_application_profile
discoveredTools.description: Get detailed runtime behavior profile for a specific workload. Shows what processes run, what files are accessed, what system calls are made, and what capabilities are used per container. Compare with CVE findings to prioritize remediation - focus on vulnerabilities affecting actively used components.

discoveredTools.name: kubescape_get_configuration_scan
discoveredTools.description: Get detailed configuration security scan results for a specific workload, including failed controls and remediation guidance.

discoveredTools.name: kubescape_get_network_neighborhood
discoveredTools.description: Get detailed network connections for a specific workload. Shows all observed ingress and egress traffic with DNS names, IPs, ports, and protocols. Use this to verify if a workload with a vulnerability is actually exposed to the network.

discoveredTools.name: kubescape_get_vulnerability_details
discoveredTools.description: Get detailed information about a specific CVE in a vulnerability manifest, including affected packages and fix information.

discoveredTools.name: kubescape_list_application_profiles
discoveredTools.description: List ApplicationProfiles showing runtime behavior of workloads. These profiles capture: executed processes (Execs), file access patterns (Opens), system calls (Syscalls), Linux capabilities used, and HTTP endpoints. Use this data to prioritize vulnerability findings - a CVE in an unused package is lower priority than one in an actively running process. Requires 'capabilities.runtimeObservability=enable' in Kubescape Helm chart.

discoveredTools.name: kubescape_list_configuration_scans
discoveredTools.description: List configuration security scan results from Kubescape operator. Shows workloads that have been scanned for security misconfigurations.

discoveredTools.name: kubescape_list_network_neighborhoods
discoveredTools.description: List NetworkNeighborhoods showing actual network communication patterns of workloads. These capture: ingress connections (who talks TO the workload), egress connections (who the workload talks TO), including DNS names, IP addresses, ports, and protocols. Use this to understand attack surface and prioritize network-related security findings. Requires 'capabilities.runtimeObservability=enable' in Kubescape Helm chart.

discoveredTools.name: kubescape_list_vulnerabilities

discoveredTools.name: kubescape_list_vulnerability_manifests
discoveredTools.description: List vulnerability manifests from Kubescape operator. Returns vulnerability scan results at image or workload level.
